## 🌟 Standout Features

### Laundry Commerce Specific

Every README includes **actual laundry business examples**:

- **Services**: Wash & Fold, Dry Cleaning, Ironing, Express
- **Pricing**: Weight-based, volume discounts, urgency surcharges
- **Preferences**: Detergent type, fabric softener, hangers
- **Item Tracking**: Type, material, weight, special instructions
- **Workflows**: Order estimation, processing, notifications
